name: Ape Core
summary:
🌿 Welcome to ApeCore! 🍌
A chill forest adventure with your fellow apes.
Just hang out, explore, and goof around!

🧩 Features:
🖥️ In-Game Computer (Change your name & more)

⛔ Ban System powered by PlayFab

🌐 Multiplayer with Photon VR

🌞 Beautiful Lighting with Universal RP

Climb trees, swing with friends, and enjoy the freedom of the wild.
This isn’t just a game, it’s a whole jungle playground. 🐒
